claude_proposed_widenings.name: Effect.half_of_fail_damage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Fireball deals half damage on a successful save. The surface Effect type only has { kind: 'damage', amount } and { kind: 'none' }. 'Half as much' is a relative quantity: at base it is 4d6, but at slot 4 it is 4.5d6 — not expressible as an integer DiceExpr. The onSuccess amount cannot be independently specified as a DiceAmount that correctly tracks the upcasted onFail amount. A new variant { kind: 'half_of_fail_damage' } (no extra fields needed; the type implies half the onFail expression, rounded down per SRD) is the minimum honest addition.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one
